summary.text: Aaron Zimmer is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Stephen Harding, Jr. (R / Independent Party of Connecticut).
He was the Democratic, Working Families Party and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 107 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Zimmer lost the 2024 general election for House District 107 to incumbent Marty Foncello, receiving 47.4 percent of the vote to Foncello's 52.6 percent.
